IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

## Cyber Security Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement cyber security software applications and systems, ensuring they are fully integrated, well-documented, and aligned with organisational security standards
- Develop and enforce secure coding practices across the software development lifecycle, embedding security controls at every stage from design through to deployment
- Conduct comprehensive security testing, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing on software, systems, and infrastructure to identify and address potential risks
- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation
- Liaise with internal stakeholders, including IT, compliance, and senior leadership, to provide clear reporting on security risks, incidents, and remediation progress
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security engineering or information security role, ideally within a complex enterprise environment
- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles
- Experience integrating security controls into DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, or Bash
- Familiarity with cloud security concepts and platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex security risks and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
- Experience working within regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
- Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act requirements, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation that places cyber security at the heart of its technology strategy, giving you genuine influence over how security is designed and delivered
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working arrangement that supports a healthy work-life balance
- Work within a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career progression into senior and leadership roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Software Engineering Discipline Lead - Simulation & Defence Systems | Victoria | Hybrid | Full-time   Your new company     
 Join an Australian engineering firm developing advanced simulation and motion technologies used across the defence sector. The company designs and builds high-fidelity driver training simulators for military vehicles integrating robotics, control systems, and immersive software to replicate real-world driving conditions with precision. 
   Your new role     
 You'll lead a team of 13 software engineers working on complex, real-world systems. Your focus is on: 
   
 
 
 Building a strong, scalable software team 
 
 
 Driving delivery and prioritisation 
 
 
 Lifting engineering discipline, quality, and assurance 
 
 
 Mentoring engineers at different stages of their careers    
 
 
 There is an established Principal Engineer in the structure. You're not expected to be the deepest technical specialist in the room, but you must come from a software engineering background. And be able to guide, challenge, and support engineers credibly. 
 You'll work closely with senior leadership and be the main interface for software delivery, performance, and team health. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 
 A software engineer by background (C++ experience strongly preferred) 
 
 
 Proven experience leading software teams 
 
 
 Comfortable balancing delivery, people leadership, and technical oversight 
 
 
 Able to step in when engineers are stuck and give practical guidance 
 
 
 Experience with Agile environments and tools like Jira 
 
 
 Exposure to safety-critical, regulated, or complex engineering environments is highly regarded. 
 
 
 Australian citizenship (eligibility for Defence Security Clearance required) 
 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 
 A growing engineering organisation with a mix of senior and junior engineers 
 
 
 A business that has tripled in size over the last three years 
 
 
 Clear ambition to expand internationally, with long-term growth opportunities for senior leaders 
 
 
 The chance to shape a team and leave a visible mark, not just maintain the status quo 
 
 
   What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or e-mail directly to lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Job Description
AI Talent is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to become a key part of our expanding team. In this role, you’ll act as the crucial link between development and operations, driving the automation and optimisation of our deployment processes. You will collaborate with developers to streamline CI/CD pipelines, enhance system reliability, and ensure secure, scalable infrastructure throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Experience:
- Minimum 6 years of full-time experience in a DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering role.
Skills:
- Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for rapid and reliable software delivery.
- Automate software build, test and deployment processes using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
- Monitor system performance, availability and security across environments using industry-standard tools.
- Write and maintain scripts for infrastructure automation and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Bash).
- Collaborate with developers and QA to troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
- Conduct root cause analysis, implement preventative measures, and optimise system processes.
- Maintain detailed technical documentation including deployment guides, monitoring plans and recovery procedures.
- Perform security assessments, manage encryption protocols, and support compliance audits.
- Contribute to the development of internal tools to improve efficiency, system visibility, and automation.
- Drive continuous integration, delivery, and improvement strategies across the SDLC.
Requirements:
- Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
- Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to high standards.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Certified in relevant DevOps or cloud technologies (e.g. AWS, Azure, TOSCA, Kubernetes, ServiceNow Admin).
- Experience with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Selenium, and ServiceNow.
Job Details:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)

result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced ICT Support Technicians NEC to join our clients' business D Power Australia Pty Ltd in Tarneit. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

Aim of the role:

- To provide efficient and reliable ICT support across hardware, software, and network systems. 
- To ensure smooth day-to-day operation of ICT systems and assist users with technical issues. 
- To support the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of computer systems and applications. 

Responsible for: Maintaining effective ICT support services and ensuring optimal performance of systems, networks, and equipment. 

Accountable to: IT Manager / Operations Manager 

Performance appraisal: Three months after appointment, then at least annually and/or when required. 

Job Descriptions:

- Determining software and hardware requirements and providing solutions to technical problems. 
- Responding to queries and support requests related to software, hardware, and system issues. 
- Installing, configuring, and downloading appropriate software and applications. 
- Adapting existing programs and systems to meet user requirements. 
- Ensuring efficient use of applications, systems, and ICT equipment. 
- Implementing, maintaining, and supporting computer networks and systems. 
- Designing, updating, and maintaining websites and online systems where required. 
- Repairing and replacing peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, and modems. 
- Providing support via help desk or call centre systems, including logging and tracking issues. 
- Setting up user accounts, permissions, and system access rights. 
- Assisting with system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities. 
- Monitoring system performance and escalating complex technical issues when required. 
- Supporting data backups, recovery procedures, and ICT security compliance. 
- Providing guidance and basic training to users on systems and applications. 
- Maintaining accurate records of support activities, incidents, and resolutions. 

Requirements:

- Experience in ICT support, help desk, or technical support roles. 
- Strong knowledge of computer hardware, software, and troubleshooting. 
- Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi). 
- Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently. 
- Strong communication and customer service skills. 
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
- Good problem-solving and time management skills. 

Qualifications/Experience:

- Experience in ICT support or technical help desk environment. 
- Qualifications in Information Technology or related field (preferred). 
- Familiarity with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and ICT systems. 
- Understanding of IT service management and support processes. 

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super 

Location: Kiosk 2, Riverdale Village Shopping Centre, Davis Road, Tarneit, Victoria, 3029

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.
